testee.compile_cost_definition: AOT (requirements 3): every phase from pattern text to a loadable object, each timed -- `emit-c` (the pcrec CLI), `gcc` (the artifact + shim into a .so), `load` (dlopen). Median of N with spread is the REPORTER's reduction; the record keeps the raw trials.
